subjects.title: The Zscaler SDKs against ZCC: where their behavior is described
The Python SDK's two ZCC clients: OneAPI service and legacy helper
subjects.lead: On a OneAPI client, `client.zcc` is a `ZCCService` built on first use and kept.

subjects.title: The Python SDK's ZCC entitlement methods: what they read and why they cannot write
subjects.lead: For ZCC responses, the Python SDK wraps a single-object body in a one-item list, so its entitlement getters work whether the API returns one object or a list.

subjects.title: Paging through ZCC lists with the Python SDK
subjects.lead: The application-profiles list returns a `policies` envelope, which `get_application_profiles` unwraps itself.

subjects.title: What the Python SDK's ZCC methods return, and the ones that break the tuple convention
subjects.lead: `get_web_privacy` returns a bare None when the request cannot be built, when it fails, or when the body cannot be read, instead of a tuple with an error.
